answer: Each new agent posts a 30-POA escrow deposit for a jade seal backed by two sponsors at 10 POA each. Referrals go on a public atlas, so 100 fakes sharing one sponsor form a star. Any peer may dispute a seal; if forged, deposit and sponsors' stakes burn. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA against 2,500 POA of fake earnings at most, so the delta stays negative. An honest agent pays one deposit, reclaims it in 20 epochs, and keeps full rewards.
